youtube_short.title: Your Savings Account Is Costing You $710K
title_alternatives: The $710K Mistake 66% of Americans Are Making
youtube_short.description:
Most people think a big savings account means you're being smart with money. But the math is brutal. $50K at 4% in a savings account for 30 years gives you $162,000. The same money in an index fund averaging 10%? You end up with $872,000. That's a $710,000 gap — from money you were never going to touch anyway.

66% of Americans are making this exact mistake right now, and inflation is eating their savings alive on top of it.

Watch to get the simple 3-step fix.
